keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Chiheb Laabidi (CD Nacional).
Delay in match because of an injury Gábor Szalai (Marítimo).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Paulo Henrique (Marítimo) is shown the yellow card.
Miguel Baeza (CD Nacional) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Marítimo 0, CD Nacional 1. Song Min-Kyu (CD Nacional) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the left to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Miguel Baeza following a fast break.
Gábor Szalai (Marítimo) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Marítimo 0, CD Nacional 1.
Substitution, Marítimo. Maurice Boakye replaces Raphael Guzzo.
Goal! Marítimo 0, CD Nacional 2. Markus Jensen (CD Nacional) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Chiheb Laabidi.
William Kokolo (CD Nacional) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, CD Nacional. José Gomes replaces William Kokolo.
Maurice Boakye (Marítimo) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Marítimo. Samuel Bamba replaces Paulo Henrique.
Substitution, Marítimo. Nilton Varela replaces Simo Bouzaidi.
Renato Marin (CD Nacional) is shown the yellow card.
Francisco Gonçalves (CD Nacional) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, CD Nacional. Stavros Gavriel replaces Pablo Ruan.
Substitution, CD Nacional. Wesley Andrade replaces Markus Jensen.
Substitution, CD Nacional. Matchoi Djaló replaces Abdel Njoya.
Substitution, CD Nacional. Allen Obando replaces Song Min-Kyu.
Substitution, Marítimo. Maxime Dominguez replaces Rodrigo Andrade.
Matchoi Djaló (CD Nacional) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
